people: Burkhard Balz (Member of the Executive Board of the Deutsche Bundesbank since 1 September 2018)
move: from twenty years at Commerzbank AG, latterly head of department for institutional clients in Hanover (2004-2009), to the Executive Board of the Deutsche Bundesbank (from 1 September 2018)
summary: The Bundesbank's own curriculum vitae for Executive Board member Burkhard Balz records a career at Commerzbank AG: trained as a bank clerk in Hanover 1989-1991, a corporate-banking traineeship 2000-2001, desk officer at the bank's liaison office to the European Union in Brussels 2001-2002, corporate customer adviser 2002-2004 and head of department for institutional clients in Hanover 2004-2009, before a term as a Member of the European Parliament and his appointment to the Executive Board on 1 September 2018. Ownership evidence: the Bundesbank page states the employment only and says nothing about who owns Commerzbank AG; Commerzbank is already carried on this map as a private-finance employer from the Weidmann record for the same country, and is a listed commercial bank.
source_title: Burkhard Balz, Member of the Executive Board of the Deutsche Bundesbank (Deutsche Bundesbank)

parties.role: employed an official before or after (revolving door)

refused_reason: Refused at round 70. Both Bundesbank CV URLs for Balz now serve the CV of his successor, Dr Philipp Nimmermann; the dated Commerzbank career the agent reported is no longer at the cited address, and no live source carrying those dates was found. The career is real and well attested without dates in conference biographies, which is not enough for this row. Lead: a Bundesbank archive or publikationen.bundesbank.de copy of the pre-2026 page.
